entry.name: leftClickAction
entry.label: What happens when you left click on the widget.

entry.name: rightClickAction
entry.label: What happens when you right click on the widget.

entry.name: scrollEnabled
entry.label: Whether scrolling the mouse on the widget changes the current desktop.

entry.name: scrollInverted
entry.label: Whether scrolling inverts which desktop is selected.

entry.name: scrollHorizontal
entry.label: Whether horizontal scrolling changes the current desktop.

entry.name: navigationWrap
entry.label: Whether the desktop navigation stops at the end or wraps around.

entry.name: singleRow
entry.label: Whether the widget displays in a single row, or follows Plasma's configuration.

entry.name: indicatorType
entry.label: Which style of desktop indicator will be used.

entry.name: indicatorSpacing
entry.label: The amount of spacing between indicators.

entry.name: textRotation
entry.label: How indicator text will be rotated on vertical panels.

entry.name: minimalStyle
entry.label: What style of minimal indicator to display.

entry.name: minimalCharActive
entry.label: The unicode character used for the active desktop indicator.

entry.name: minimalCharInactive
entry.label: The unicode character used for the inactive desktop indicator.

entry.name: minimalSizeMode
entry.label: How the size of indicator characters is rendered.

entry.name: minimalSizeCustom
entry.label: Indicator size in pixels when minimalSizeMode is "custom".

entry.name: minimalCustomColors
entry.label: Allow indicator text colours to be customised.

entry.name: minimalColorActive
entry.label: Colour of the current desktop's indicator when minimalCustomColors is "custom".

entry.name: minimalColorInactive
entry.label: Colour of inactive desktop indicators when minimalCustomColors is "custom".
